PropertyValue.String: Reads information on the header data of process orders.
Reads information available on the header data of existing process orders. You can use the standard OData system query options to refine your request.
Reads information on the header data of a single process order.
Reads the information for a specific process order that you specify using the process order number.
Reads the operations of process orders.
Reads information available on the operations of existing process orders. You can use the standard OData system query options to refine your request.
Reads information on a single operation.
Reads the information of a single operation that you specify using the internal routing number for operations and the internal ID of an operation.
Reads the data of process order components.
Reads the data of process order components. You can use the standard OData system query options to refine your request.
Reads the data of a single component.
Reads the data for a single process order component that you specify using the reservation number and the reservation item number.
Reads the data of process order items.
Reads the data of process order items. You can use the standard OData system query options to refine your request.
Reads the data of a single item.
Reads the data for a single process order item that you specify using the process order number and the process order item number.
Reads the status of process orders.
Reads information available on the status of existing process orders. You can use the standard OData system query options to refine your request.
Reads the status of a single process order.
Reads the status of a single process order that you specify using the process order number and the status code.
Reads the production resources/tools (PRTs) of process orders.
Reads information available on the production resources/tools (PRTs) of existing process orders. You can use the standard OData system query options to refine your request.
Reads the information on a single production resource/tool (PRT) for an operation.
Reads the information of a single production resource/tool (PRT) that you specify using the internal routing number and the item counter for PRTs.
Creates a new process order.
Creates the header data for a new process order using the properties you provide.
Updates header data of a process order.
Updates some of the header data of a process order. You can update the scheduling type, date and time information and information on quantities.
Updates component data of a process order.
Updates some of the component data of a process order. You can update the required quantity, storage location, and batch number.
Reads the header data of a process order including the operations.
Reads the header data of a single process order that you specify using the process order number. The response includes information on the operations belonging to the order.
Reads the header data of a process order including the components.
Reads the header data of a process order you specify using the process order number. The response includes information on the components belonging to the order.
Reads the header data of a process order including the items.
Reads the header data of a single process order that you specify using the process order number. The response includes information on the items belonging to the order.
Reads the header data of a process order including the status.
Reads the header data of a single process order that you specify using the process order number. The response includes information on the status of the order.
Reads the header data of a process order including the production resources/tools (PRTs).
Reads the header data of a single process order that you specify using the process order number. The response includes information on the production resources/tools (PRTs) assigned to the order.

Annotation.String: Releases a process order.
Releases a process order that you specify using the process order number.
Releases an operation of a process order.
Releases an operation of a process order that you specify using the process order number and the operation number.
Technically completes a process order.
Technically completes a process order that you specify using the process order number.
Closes a process order.
Closes a process order that you specify using the process order number.
Sets the deletion flag for a process order.
Sets the deletion flag for a process order that you specify using the process order number.
Sets the deletion indicator for a process order.
Sets the deletion indicator for a process order that you specify using the process order number.
Discards a process order.
Discards a process order that you specify using the process order number.
Converts a planned order into a process order.

Converts a planned order that you specify using the planned order number into a process order. You can use external numbering for the process order if required. The planned order gets deleted after the conversion.
Schedules order operations.

Schedules process order operations to be dispatched or deallocated using the scheduling mode and scheduling strategy. You can either choose the dates or retain the operation dates to dispatch the orders.
Sets the final delivery indicator for a process order.
Sets the final delivery indicator for a process order that you specify using the process order number.
Sets the status ReleasedByMES for a process order.
Sets the status ReleasedByMES for a process order that you specify using the process order number.
